reviews.title: It is not detecting my device anymore
reviews.text: Worked great until the last two days. Now it doesn’t detect my LG smart tv at all. Maybe the app is due for an update? I see it’s been five months since the last one. This was not a free app, $49!

reviews.title: Less than mediocre
reviews.text: The remote doesn’t work and has so many adds it feels useless. I’d rather use my physical remote instead of this app. I’m not saying no adds for free I’m just saying less adds and more useful would be nice. I don’t recommend this app and if there was a no star option I’d pick that. I’m not keeping the app. It’s useless at this point. Not waisting the money either.
